comment: Client ROE waterfall per fiscal year (Client Profitability, mv_roe_waterfall): revenue -> opex (allocated cost) -> credit cost (expected loss) -> pre-tax profit -> tax -> net income -> allocated capital -> ROE, for FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026 to date (Apr-Sep 2026, flows not annualised; ratios annualised). Built from gold.fact_client_revenue_monthly, so amounts tie to the monthly fact. ROE = annualised net income / average allocated capital (12.5% of RWA; hurdle 10%); RoRWA and RAROC use the relationship-P&L net profit (hurdles 1.2% and 12%) - the same definitions as the monthly fact. Ratios are winsorised to -0.25..1.00 for display while the below-hurdle flags use the unwinsorised ratios; aggregate ROE = SUM(net_income_annualised_usd) / SUM(avg_allocated_capital_usd). Flows add across clients (not across years of one client); average balances add across clients. Grain: one row per golden client x fiscal year (FY2026 = year to date).
